name: Should backsplash tile be installed before or after new countertops?

mainEntity.name: Should backsplash tile be installed before or after new countertops?

acceptedAnswer.text: Kitchen backsplash tile should almost always be installed after new countertops and cabinetry are in place. Setting cabinets and countertops first establishes fixed, level horizontal boundaries against which your tile can align accurately. If tile is installed beforehand, measuring the exact height of the counter is difficult, often leading to awkward tile cuts, uneven gaps, or potential tile damage when heavy countertop slabs are lowered into position. Waiting until counters are secured ensures a tight, professional caulk joint along the counter edge.
acceptedAnswer.description: Backsplash tile should be installed after countertops and cabinets are installed to guarantee accurate alignment, proper clearances, and clean joints.
